Reference-cycle, [[file:glossary.org::#term/inheritance][inheritance]], override, and closed-list checks remain shared with the CRUD implementation.

* 12. hiccup-element
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: web/hiccup-element
:FILE: resources/packages/web/html/impls.clj
:LINE: 26
:MINS: 0.9
:END:

Constructs a [[file:glossary.org::#term/hiccup][Hiccup]] element from tag, attributes, and children. Graph-composed pages use it to build markup, including ~data-action~ attributes handled by the browser runtime and [[file:glossary.org::#term/htmx][HTMX]] attributes requesting [[file:glossary.org::#term/htmx][server-rendered fragments]]. This creates markup; browser interaction still requires the corresponding runtime.

* 18. candidate-fit
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: web/candidate-fit
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/types_api.clj
:LINE: 595
:MINS: 2.2
:END:

Ranks already-admissible function candidates by how their parameters fit a callable [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]]. ~:exact~ uses the supplied parameter count, ~:captures~ needs additional [[file:glossary.org::#term/capture][captured input]], and ~:ignores~ consumes fewer parameters. Ranking changes display order, not whether the type checker admits a candidate.

Synchronizes function definitions into a specified branch for [[file:glossary.org::#term/mcp][MCP]] and bundle-import callers. It uses the same synchronization checks as packaged definitions and invalidates the target branch's [[file:glossary.org::#term/compiled-registry][compiled registry]]. The target may differ from the branch carrying the HTTP request.
